researched.notes: Public site is a frameset; product detail read from the Azure-hosted app it loads.

researched.description: HousingOS and ApplicationOS software for municipal housing departments to run CDBG, HOME and local rehabilitation programs from application intake through construction, loan servicing and compliance reporting.
researched.notes: Contact page states only a Southern California office, no city; copyright range 2000-2026 is not a stated founding year.

researched.notes: No website in source row; found at kansosoftware.com. Offices listed in Denver, CO and West Salem, WI.
Custom software consulting and development services, not a product; builds bespoke apps for housing authorities, universities and healthcare clients.

researched.description: Cloud electronic health record and revenue cycle software for behavioral health and substance use providers, county health departments, CCBHCs and state Medicaid-funded programs.
researched.notes: Site names government agencies, county health departments and government contract vehicles as primary markets.
Data science consulting, staffing and training services rather than a software product; no government or behavioral health agency market named on the site.

Real software product (MediKey, HealthEligible) for Medicaid enrollment and benefits screening, but named buyers lead with health systems and FQHCs, with government agencies among several markets; HQ Providence, RI, founded 2024 if promoted.

Hybrid software plus consulting firm serving 60+ nonprofit community behavioral health provider agencies; site names no county or state government client, and the AI product is described as still being built with early agencies.
AI revenue cycle automation sold across private healthcare specialties (physical therapy, dental, dermatology, radiology, behavioral health); no government or public agency buyer named.
Behavioral health EHR marketed to solo, group and community provider practices; Medicaid and Medicare billing is referenced but no county or state agency is named as a customer.

researched.description: Policy management, accreditation, training, scheduling and wellness software for law enforcement, fire, EMS, corrections and 911 dispatch agencies; a brand of NEOGOV.
researched.notes: Contact page lists NEOGOV at 2120 Park Pl, El Segundo, CA as the physical address.

Beacon is a dispatch tool from Trek Medics International, a nonprofit filing Form 990; deployments described are largely international low-resource emergency services and alternative crisis response networks rather than US local government purchasers.

researched.description: Hosted digital collections and digital asset management platform used by public libraries, museums, archives and university libraries to publish and search their special collections.
researched.notes: Vendor site returned 403; sector pages for public libraries, museums and archives and for universities and colleges confirmed via search. AM (Adam Matthew Digital) is UK-based, so no US City, ST is recorded.
Adobe consumer art app for kids and families distributed free through app stores; no library, school or public sector purchasing named, and Adobe overall is a horizontal vendor.
